summary: Agomab Therapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the design of its NOV-ERA Phase 2b study with ontunisertib in Fibrostenosing Crohn's Disease. The filing describes regulatory alignment with the FDA on study design, including a novel primary endpoint of endoscopic passability, and plans to dose first participants in H2 2026. It does not involve any special situation; it is a routine clinical-stage business update from a foreign private issuer.
